column1: # One list of pads and the prompt set each must get, read by the launcher (app/src/input.rs), the Rust runtime
# (crates/runtime/src/platform.rs) and the C++ runtime (tests/controller_kind_test.cpp): the three classifiers
# must agree on every row. Columns, tab-separated: USB vendor id, product id (hex, 0 when unknown), name, kind.
# Kind is switch, xbox, playstation, generic, or deck (the launcher draws Steam Deck art; the game treats the Deck
# as generic, which it shows with the Xbox icons).
